notes.title: Fixing Linux Build 1 Step at a time!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

I'm glad to say that thanks to the support of some linux users
I've been able to fix the play button of Dämmerlicht.

You should now be able to play Dämmerlicht by launching it from steam

If any more problems arise please do tell me.

I'll now be focusing my effort on fixing the save problem on Linux.
I know that not being able to save your progress is really frustrating,
so I wan't to fix that issue as soon as possible. I might have an idea
of what the problem could be, but once again I'm not familiar with
linux at all, so I'm asking for everyone to be a bit patient.

Know that I'm doing my best to fix every problem each user is facing,
as well as trying to make Dämmerlicht a better game for everyone to
enjoy.

notes.title: !Bug Report - Linux!
notes.notes:
I'm sad to announce that at the moment,
Dämmerlicht doesn't seem to be able to 
save on LINUX machines.

I'm currently trying to find a solution
to this problem, sorry about that
to all Linux user.

The game will not start by itself if you try
to run it from your steam library either.

I'm aware of both of those problem and I'm currently 
trying to solve those problems, but as I'm not
a Linux user myself these problems might be a bit complicated
to fix, but I'm trying my best at the moment.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.1 was just released,

the main goal of this patch is to fix the bug present in level 4-1
that prevented you from going back to the main map as
advancing to the next level.

it also correct 1 or 2 grammar mistake at the same time
(more correction to comes)

finally it allows the player to attack using the mouse
(left and right click and you should be able to
block with anyother button on your mouse)

If you run into anyother problems especially
regarding the linux and OSX build please post
them in the game's discussion or send me
and email at RoyalTeaTimeStudio@gmail.com

Also thanks to everyone who purchased the game
so far, we're off to a good start and thank you
for all the support.
